description: This file declares the StateHandler class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which manages lifecycle state transitions, creation, and validation for a system component. It includes static methods for initializing, changing states, creating state objects, validating transitions, and updating states, along with static data members for tracking state transitions and state strings.

classes.name: StateHandler
classes.description: A class providing static methods and data members to manage lifecycle states, including initialization, state changes, creation, validation, and updates within the plugin namespace.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the StateHandler, setting up necessary state management resources.

methods.name: changeState
methods.description: Attempts to change the system's lifecycle state based on a request, returning success or failure and an error reason.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates a new State object corresponding to a given lifecycle state within a specific application context.

methods.name: isValidTransition
methods.description: Checks if transitioning from a start state to a target state is valid based on the defined transition paths.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the current state of the application context to a new lifecycle state, reporting errors if any.
